title: material nav icons restored
description:
Owner request (2026-11-12): revert the main bottom navigation
glyphs to the pre-1ca091d Material icon pairs. The vendored
ic_nav_* drawables added in 1ca091d are gone; the owner
specifically wanted the stock Material Settings gear with its
center detail back, plus PlayArrow (library), AutoMirrored List
(projects), and AutoMirrored ExitToApp (exports), each as an
outlined/filled pair from the cached core Material set.

The Destination enum returns to ImageVector fields
(outlined/filled) exactly as the pre-1ca091d reference, and the
NavigationBarItem icon slot renders via Icon(imageVector, ...).
Nothing else about the nav changed: layout, labels, Monet
selected/unselected tinting, and the indicator pill all come from
stock NavigationBar defaults and are untouched, as is the rest of
the P2+3 redesign. The old stand-ins comment was superseded by
the owner's explicit preference and now record
